retained_v6_artifacts.notes: Exact retained bytes. The source contains private host paths and nonces; neither is copied into this inventory.
The V6 entry binds authorization ID, transition 5-to-6, ledger/evidence roots, run prefix, and the V5 predecessor hash.

v6_failure_characterization.root_cause: The V6 diagnostic required a nonempty checkpoint_method on every row, while the production Registry contract deliberately accepts an omitted checkpoint_method and falls back to the already captured pure to_save_data owner state as the rollback checkpoint.

checkpoint_contract_findings.omitted_field_semantics: For an omitted checkpoint_method, _capture_owner_checkpoint_detailed first calls to_save_data. If no explicit checkpoint was captured, it duplicates that pure Dictionary into rollback_checkpoint. _rollback_sections then calls the declared rollback_method (apply_save_data for all 11 rows), recaptures the owner, and requires encoded equality. _verify_checkpoints_exact performs the final all-owner residual check.
